questions.text: Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with Parker-Hannifin and/or CIRCOR A&D and the products you typically acquire from them (if applicable).

Do you consider Parker-Hannifin and CIRCOR A&D to be close competitors in Australia? For example, do they supply products you consider to be substitutable with each other? Please focus on products which are supplied in Australia or have the potential to be.

Are alternative suppliers available that compete with Parker-Hannifin and CIRCOR A&D in relation to the products you identified in response to question 2? Are they comparable in terms of the price, availability, and quality of products?
Are either of Parker-Hannifin or CIRCOR A&D major suppliers to competitors of each other?
Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition.
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.
